service_airport.title: Airport Transfers Nationwide
service_airport.hero_desc: Punctual, stress-free luxury airport chauffeur transfers across Sydney (SYD), Melbourne (MEL), Brisbane (BNE), Perth (PER), and Adelaide (ADL). Real-time commercial flight monitoring and inside-terminal meet-and-greet included.
service_airport.f1_desc: We monitor your flight status automatically. Early arrivals or flight delays are accounted for with adjusted chauffeur arrival times at zero extra hassle.
service_airport.f2_desc: Your chauffeur greets you inside the arrivals hall holding a personalized digital name board, ready to escort you and manage your luggage.
service_airport.f3_desc: Receive your chauffeur's name, direct phone number, and vehicle registration well prior to touchdown for total peace of mind.
service_airport.detail_desc: Navigating busy Australian airport terminals after a long flight shouldn't involve rideshare delays or queuing in the taxi rank. Our executive airport transfers provide door-to-door comfort, luggage assistance, and climate-controlled travel.
service_airport.check1: Complimentary bottled spring water & onboard Wi-Fi
service_airport.check2: 60 minutes complimentary waiting time on international arrivals
service_airport.check3: 30 minutes complimentary waiting time on domestic arrivals
service_airport.faq_subtitle: Common questions regarding our airport pickup and drop-off protocols.
service_airport.q1: What happens if my flight is delayed?
service_airport.a1: Our dispatch team monitors live airline telemetry. Your pickup time adjusts dynamically with your revised landing time, ensuring your driver is there when you land.
service_airport.q2: Where will my chauffeur meet me?
service_airport.a2: Your chauffeur will wait inside the terminal near the luggage carousel exit holding an executive digital name sign.
service_airport.q3: Can you provide child or booster seats?
service_airport.a3: Yes. Certified forward-facing, rear-facing, and booster child seats can be pre-installed upon request in your booking notes.
service_airport.q4: Do you service regional and international airports?
service_airport.a4: We provide full transfer coverage across all major Australian international and domestic terminals, as well as private jet FBO hangars.
service_airport.cta_title: Ready to Book Your Airport Transfer?
service_airport.cta_desc: Reserve in under 2 minutes or request a transparent corporate quote.

service_corporate.hero_desc: Designed specifically for Executive Assistants, travel procurement managers, and corporate leadership. Centralized monthly invoicing, priority dispatch, and nationwide multi-city management across Australia.

service_corporate.f3_desc: One reliable provider handling boardroom and airport transit across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, and Canberra.
service_corporate.detail_title: Why Executive Assistants Choose Elite Cars
service_corporate.detail_desc: Managing executive travel demands flawless punctuality and complete confidentiality. We provide full visibility to EAs before every pickup, eliminating guesswork.
service_corporate.check1: Chauffeur name, mobile, & rego sent ahead to booker and passenger
service_corporate.check2: Tailored account terms with zero hidden booking surcharges
service_corporate.check3: Strict confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements for all drivers
service_corporate.check4: Premium sedans (Mercedes S-Class) and people movers (V-Class, Sprinter)
service_corporate.faq_subtitle: Answers to common questions about setting up a business account.
service_corporate.q1: How do I set up a corporate invoicing account?
service_corporate.a1: Simply fill out our enquiry form or call our team. We can activate corporate account billing and credit terms within 24 hours.
service_corporate.q2: Can multiple assistants or bookers charge to one account?
service_corporate.a2: Yes. We can configure authorized bookers with PO numbers or project codes to simplify reconciliation.
service_corporate.q3: What notice is required for bookings?
service_corporate.a3: While advance notice is recommended, corporate account clients receive priority dispatch for short-notice transfers.
service_corporate.q4: Are rates fixed across different Australian cities?
service_corporate.a4: Yes, corporate accounts benefit from standardized, transparent route pricing across all supported Australian metropolitan areas.
service_corporate.cta_desc: Get in touch with our executive accounts coordinator today to establish your company account.

service_hourly.title: As-Directed Chauffeur Hire
service_hourly.hero_desc: Retain a dedicated luxury vehicle and private chauffeur on standby for as many hours as your schedule requires. Ideal for dynamic executive agendas, multi-stop business meetings, and VIP city itineraries.
service_hourly.f1_desc: Direct your chauffeur from stop to stop without worrying about pre-set routes or waiting fees. Your vehicle remains on immediate standby.
service_hourly.f2_desc: Work on confidential files or take private phone calls in complete tranquility inside a whisper-quiet luxury cabin.
service_hourly.f3_desc: Chauffeurs equipped with live traffic routing knowledge to ensure smooth transit between Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane CBDs and beyond.
service_hourly.detail_title: Bespoke Chauffeured Mobility On Your Terms
service_hourly.detail_desc: When your business day involves multiple meetings, site visits, or unpredictable finish times, as-directed hire guarantees seamless transportation waiting at the kerb whenever you emerge.
service_hourly.check1: Minimum 2-hour booking duration with flexible extensions
service_hourly.check2: Available in Mercedes-Benz S-Class, BMW 7, GLS, and V-Class vans
service_hourly.check3: Climate control, onboard phone charging, and complimentary spring water
service_hourly.check4: All parking, tolls, and waiting periods handled seamlessly
service_hourly.faq_subtitle: Common details regarding hourly and daily chauffeur bookings.
service_hourly.q1: What is the minimum hire period?
service_hourly.a1: Our standard as-directed hourly bookings start at a 2-hour minimum, with full-day and multi-day packages available.
service_hourly.q2: Can I change destinations spontaneously during the trip?
service_hourly.a2: Yes. Simply inform your chauffeur where you need to go next. The vehicle is solely dedicated to you throughout your booked hours.
service_hourly.q3: Are tolls and parking included in hourly rates?
service_hourly.a3: Standard CBD travel tolls are included. Any specialized commercial parking fees incurred while waiting at your request are itemized transparently.
service_hourly.q4: Can I book an as-directed van for a small delegation?
service_hourly.a4: Yes, our Mercedes-Benz V-Class (up to 7 passengers) is ideal for executive teams and delegation travel.
service_hourly.cta_desc: Provide your estimated itinerary or hours, and our team will confirm your dedicated vehicle and driver.

service_roadshows.title: Corporate Roadshows & Investor Itineraries
service_roadshows.hero_desc: Precision transport logistics for high-stakes investor roadshows, capital raisings, board meetings, and multi-city executive presentations across Australia.
service_roadshows.f1_desc: Our dispatch managers review your meeting timetable and model Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane peak-hour traffic buffers to ensure zero delays.
service_roadshows.f2_desc: Deploy matching Mercedes-Benz S-Class sedans and V-Class executive vans for travelling deal teams, legal counsel, and banking executives.
service_roadshows.f3_desc: Your EA or roadshow coordinator gets a dedicated dispatch manager overseeing the live progress of all vehicles simultaneously.
service_roadshows.detail_desc: When presenting to investors or closing acquisitions, every minute counts. Our senior roadshow chauffeurs know private building loading docks, secure basement drop-offs, and swift alternative routes.
service_roadshows.check1: Chauffeurs positioned 15 minutes ahead of scheduled depart time
service_roadshows.check2: Seamless coordination between commercial terminals and private FBOs
service_roadshows.check3: Mobile device chargers, onboard Wi-Fi, and bottled refreshments
service_roadshows.check4: Itemized invoicing broken down by deal code or company project
service_roadshows.faq_subtitle: How we manage multi-stop executive travel itineraries.
service_roadshows.q1: Can we provide a detailed spreadsheet itinerary?
service_roadshows.a1: Yes. You can email your itinerary directly to info@elitecarsaustralia.com.au. We will verify timings, routes, and confirm assigned vehicles.
service_roadshows.q2: Can roadshows span multiple Australian cities?
service_roadshows.a2: Yes. We frequently manage multi-day roadshows starting in Sydney, flying to Melbourne, and concluding in Brisbane or Perth with synchronized local chauffeurs.
service_roadshows.q3: What happens if a meeting runs over time?
service_roadshows.a3: Your chauffeur remains on standby outside the venue and will adapt the remaining route dynamically without causing panic.
service_roadshows.a4: All chauffeurs sign strict non-disclosure agreements and uphold complete discretion regarding conversations and deal materials inside the vehicle.
service_roadshows.cta_desc: Send us your itinerary for a detailed route timing review and tailored quotation.

service_events.title: Conferences & Event Transport
service_events.hero_desc: Comprehensive transport coordination for industry summits, VIP keynote speakers, boardroom retreats, and gala delegate movements across major Australian convention centres and venues.
service_events.f1_desc: From individual VIP keynote transfers in Mercedes-Benz S-Class to multi-passenger group shuttles in luxury V-Class vans and executive Sprinter minibuses.
service_events.f2_desc: Dedicated marshals and dispatch coordinators available for major conventions (ICC Sydney, MCEC Melbourne, BCEC Brisbane) to oversee arrivals and departures.
service_events.f3_desc: Polite, impeccably dressed chauffeurs providing a first-class welcoming experience reflecting positively on your brand and event sponsors.

service_events.check2: Shuttles between corporate hotels and conference venues
service_events.check3: Direct liaison with event planners and conference production staff
service_events.faq_subtitle: Key information for conference coordinators and event producers.
service_events.q1: How many delegates can your fleet accommodate?
service_events.a1: We manage transport for intimate VIP groups up to conferences requiring 100+ passenger movements across our sedans, luxury vans, and executive minibuses.

service_events.a3: Yes, we operate daily at ICC Sydney, Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre (MCEC), Brisbane Convention Centre, and major luxury hotels nationwide.

service_weddings.title: Luxury Wedding Car Hire & Bridal Chauffeurs
service_weddings.hero_desc: Make your wedding day timeless with Australia's premier luxury wedding fleet. Featuring pristine Mercedes-Benz S-Class, Mercedes Maybach, BMW 7 Series, and executive people movers for your bridal party and family.
service_weddings.f1_desc: Every bridal vehicle undergoes comprehensive detailing inside and out, arriving spotless with optional classic white wedding ribbons.
service_weddings.f2_desc: Our experienced wedding chauffeurs are immaculately dressed in formal business suits, offering courteous assistance, door opening, and dress care.
service_weddings.f3_desc: Seamless timing and patient coordination between ceremony venues, picturesque photo locations, and evening reception entrances.
service_weddings.detail_title: Grace, Elegance & Absolute Peace of Mind
service_weddings.detail_desc: Your wedding day is one of life's most memorable occasions. We eliminate transport stress with early arrival, calm guidance, and luxurious comfort for the bride, groom, and entire wedding party.
service_weddings.check1: Early chauffeur arrival buffer for calm, unhurried departures
service_weddings.check2: White wedding ribbons, bottled water, and umbrella assistance included
service_weddings.check3: Mercedes V-Class and Sprinters for bridal party and VIP guests
service_weddings.check4: End-of-night getaway transfers directly to wedding night hotels or airports
service_weddings.faq_subtitle: Frequently asked questions about reserving bridal and guest vehicles.
service_weddings.q1: How far in advance should we reserve wedding cars?
service_weddings.a1: We recommend booking 2 to 6 months in advance, especially during peak Australian wedding seasons (spring and autumn).
service_weddings.q2: Are wedding ribbons included with the vehicles?
service_weddings.a2: Yes. Complimentary white satin wedding bonnet ribbons are provided upon request for all bridal cars.
service_weddings.q3: Can we book multiple matching vehicles?
service_weddings.a3: Yes, we can provide coordinated packages featuring a lead Mercedes S-Class/Maybach accompanied by matching luxury Mercedes V-Class vans.
service_weddings.q4: Do you provide late-night reception getaway transfers?
service_weddings.a4: Yes, we offer late-night chauffeur pick-ups from reception venues to transport the newlyweds in comfort to their hotel or departing flight.
service_weddings.cta_desc: Tell us about your ceremony and reception schedule for a tailored wedding vehicle package.

service_fbo.title: Private Aviation & FBO Transfers
service_fbo.hero_desc: Discreet, seamless tarmac and FBO terminal chauffeured transfers connecting private aircraft charters, corporate jets, and VIP aviation facilities across Sydney (ExecuJet, Jet Aviation), Melbourne (Essendon, Tullamarine FBO), Brisbane, and nationwide.
service_fbo.f1_desc: We monitor private aircraft tail numbers and liaise directly with FBO handling agents and charter brokers to coordinate curbside or tarmac readiness.
service_fbo.f2_desc: High-security protocols and confidential transport for Ultra-High-Net-Worth individuals, executive delegations, dignitaries, and celebrities.
service_fbo.f3_desc: Accredited drivers familiar with VIP private jet protocols, luggage handling standards, and security procedures at Australian aviation facilities.
service_fbo.detail_desc: Private jet travel requires uncompromising timing and frictionless handoffs. Our chauffeurs are stationed at the FBO lounge before your wheels touch the runway, guaranteeing immediate departure as soon as you clear the steps.
service_fbo.check1: Direct handling coordination with ExecuJet, Jet Aviation, and local FBO operators
service_fbo.check2: Tailored for charter brokers, flight departments, and VIP family offices
service_fbo.check3: Mercedes Maybach, Mercedes S-Class, BMW 7, and luxury V-Class support vans
service_fbo.check4: Discreet tarmac luggage handling and executive assistance
service_fbo.faq_subtitle: Information for flight coordinators, pilots, and charter brokers.
service_fbo.q1: Which FBO terminals do you service in Australia?
service_fbo.a1: We service all major Australian FBOs including Sydney Airport (Jet Aviation, ExecuJet), Melbourne (Essendon Fields & Tullamarine FBO), Brisbane Airport FBO, Perth, Adelaide, and Gold Coast.
service_fbo.q2: Can you track private aircraft tail numbers?
service_fbo.a2: Yes. Simply provide your tail registration or flight identifier in the booking form. We track movement via FlightAware and radar telemetry.
service_fbo.q3: Can luggage support vans travel alongside passenger sedans?
service_fbo.a3: Yes. For flights with extensive luggage, golf clubs, or equipment, we frequently pair an S-Class or Maybach with a dedicated Mercedes V-Class or Sprinter.
service_fbo.q4: What billing options are available for charter brokers?
service_fbo.a4: We provide instant corporate invoicing, wire transfers, and credit card processing with transparent, all-inclusive pricing.
service_fbo.cta_desc: Book with our private aviation dispatch team for guaranteed on-tarmac readiness.

service_interstate.title: Interstate & Regional Chauffeur Transfers
service_interstate.hero_desc: Private, comfortable long-distance chauffeured journeys connecting capital cities and regional commercial centres across Australia (Sydney to Canberra, Melbourne to regional Victoria, Brisbane to Gold Coast / Sunshine Coast). Avoid airport queues and travel on your schedule.
service_interstate.f1_desc: Travel directly from your home or office to regional sites and interstate destinations without flight delays, security lines, or baggage restrictions.
service_interstate.f2_desc: Work uninterrupted with onboard Wi-Fi, 240V/USB laptop charging ports, leather recliners, and peaceful acoustic insulation.
service_interstate.f3_desc: Experienced long-distance highway chauffeurs adhering to fatigue management protocols, ensuring safe transit in all weather conditions.
service_interstate.detail_title: The Smarter Alternative to Short Flights
service_interstate.detail_desc: For trips like Sydney to Canberra (under 3 hours door-to-door), driving in an executive Mercedes-Benz S-Class or BMW 7 is faster and vastly more productive than commuting to an airport 90 minutes early and waiting through boarding lines.
service_interstate.check1: Popular routes: Sydney ⇄ Canberra, Sydney ⇄ Newcastle / Hunter Valley, Melbourne ⇄ Geelong
service_interstate.check2: Customized rest stops and scenic route options at your request
service_interstate.check3: High-capacity Mercedes-Benz V-Class and Sprinter vans for team travel
service_interstate.check4: Fixed, all-inclusive route pricing covering fuel, tolls, and return travel
service_interstate.faq_subtitle: Details about booking long-distance and regional chauffeur trips.
service_interstate.q1: Which interstate routes do you service most frequently?
service_interstate.a1: Our most requested routes include Sydney ⇄ Canberra, Sydney ⇄ Wollongong/Southern Highlands, Brisbane ⇄ Gold Coast / Byron Bay, and Melbourne ⇄ Mornington Peninsula.
service_interstate.q2: Can the chauffeur wait for me for a same-day return?
service_interstate.a2: Yes. Same-day return packages are very popular for corporate executives attending regional site inspections or Canberra parliamentary meetings.
service_interstate.q3: Can we bring pets or oversized luggage?
service_interstate.a3: Yes. With prior notice, our executive SUVs (GLS, X7) and V-Class vans can easily accommodate extra luggage, project equipment, or crates.
service_interstate.a4: We provide a single, transparent fixed quote for your specific route including all highway tolls and driver allowances.
service_interstate.cta_desc: Tell us your departure address and destination for an upfront, fixed-price travel quote.
